rules: the register of ledgers the shelf reads with shelf_read.cjs. append-only: a row is added at the end, by the lab (that it lands in a dated commit is lab practice; the tests check append-only across every commit of this file); a row is never edited or removed; a row taken off the shelf gets withdrawn_at (and may get withdrawn_why) and stays. a v1 row for an outside operator's ledger is added when that operator has published one and asks. the shelf is the lab's: a row here is read by the lab's shelf.

rows.name: darkflobi

anchor_place.kind: the lab's exhibit copy of each day's anchor text (anchors/<date>.txt); the telegram post itself needs an account to read, so the shelf reads the lab's copy, not the post

rows.note: the lab's own agent; the same ledger url the nightly row (shelf.config.json) reads. the nightly run also checks every anchor's opentimestamps proof against two explorers; shelf_read checks the chain and the earliest anchor only.

anchor_place.kind: the ledger's own page on the lab's github pages site; the lab can edit it, so it is not a place outside the lab
